name: Gádor (Spain)
description: Vertically divided orange and green in the proportions 1:2, charged on the division with the crowned municipal arms of Gádor (mountains above waves on blue, inscribed GADOR).
history: Municipal flag of Gádor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Gádor arms — mountains above waves on blue
